verdict.rationale: Tavily documents rate limits explicitly (100 RPM dev / 1,000 RPM production, 429 with retry-after header) and its pricing page shows a free tier with no credit card required plus pay-as-you-go scaling, implying a self-serve upgrade path. However, evidence never mentions explicit concurrency caps (only RPM) or a documented plan-tier upgrade flow/UI beyond the pricing page copy. Missing for 10: explicit concurrency limits, detailed self-serve plan upgrade mechanics/UI evidence.
